cards.definition: The query requests information or guidance about a journey, route, travel service, transport ticket or its acquisition procedure.
includes: Directions, route planning, journey distance/duration, departure/arrival times, service availability, fares and available travel options.
Searching or displaying ticket information, and asking how or where to obtain transport tickets, when an informational purpose is expressed.
Transport access points such as a station, and journey departure advice. Missing destinations or times do not invalidate a clear information request.
excludes: Purchasing/reserving alone does not imply a separate information request; only explicitly expressed lookup counts.
Opening a map/tool or displaying a geographic map without journey/route information, and standalone venue discovery/location without travel access or route purpose.
An unresolved search-versus-acquisition request remains unavailable; do not force find me a ticket into one interpretation.
cards.coexistence: Explicit booking and information requests can both be present. A purchase clause does not veto a separate availability query.

cards.definition: The query requests obtaining, purchasing, paying for or reserving a transport ticket, seat or booked passage on a transport service.
includes: An explicit purchase/reservation/payment instruction or a directed request for a transport ticket, including want/need a ticket constructions without a competing informational reading.
Booking a train ride, return journey or seat even without the word ticket; omitted route/time/value arguments do not erase the operation.
A clearly directed conditional acquisition request is present without asserting condition truth or execution.
excludes: Asking ticket prices, availability, methods or purchase locations alone; opening a ticket app alone; reading ticket information alone.
A generic wish to travel or leave is not sufficient evidence for booking. A ride with no service/ticket evidence may mean taxi hiring and remains unavailable for this definition.
Generic event tickets without transport evidence; no external identity lookup of a platform or title is used to supply a missing domain.
cards.ambiguity: Find/get/search phrasing and can I purchase may denote information, permission or acquisition; use the full expression and retain unresolved interpretations rather than assigning by native class or a verb list.
cards.coexistence: A separately requested information lookup does not cancel an acquisition request.

supervision: Fresh proposals under these definitions and the unchanged shared request policy; no automatic inheritance of old definition-fit truth.
scope: Complete 282-source native query/ticket cohort, with cross-domain rule comparison to contacts. Not exhaustive semantic annotation of all 40513 learning recordings or proof of cross-dataset model transfer.
